sources.coverage: 100 official release objects and full bodies fetched; 37 published since October 27. Seven new artifact-only objects: five Nightly, one Beta, one Release-labeled object with API prerelease=true. Thirty overlap releases were compared: 29 body hashes unchanged, and 1.98.63 now adds an explicit Android maintenance section. Publication and prerelease metadata of overlap objects are unchanged. Titles are recorded from the current source; all platform and channel labels remain distinct.

Full page byte-identical to previous observation. All 50 current note bullets indexed before selection: Desktop 16, Desktop Origin 10, Android 13, iOS 11. Latest displayed notes remain Desktop 1.98.63 and Android 1.98.60 dated October 27. Older Desktop 1.98.60 and iOS 1.96.62 entries are retained as out-of-window context, not new launches. Release-labeled API 1.99.54 and 1.98.64 still lack feature-specific bodies, so overall current channel coverage remains partial.

Full current changelog byte-identical to previous observation. Top 1.98.63 Chromium maintenance and 1.98.62 security/engine notes unchanged; the corresponding bullets are included in the source-note inventory. Historical backfill beyond the current observation is not newly claimed.

Full current file fetched. Top section is now 1.98.63 with one Chromium maintenance bullet; the release API independently supplies the same Android-specific note. Current file skips from 1.98.63 to 1.98.60. Previously observed 1.98.62 remains explicit in its release API and is preserved, not treated as withdrawn. The 13 Android 1.98.60 issue references match the unchanged official latest page. Details for artifact-only 1.98.64 and 1.99.54 remain unverified.

Full dated current product index byte-identical to previous observation. Latest dated entry remains October 15; no October 27 onward post is present in this index. Index coverage is not a claim to have revisited all historical blog bodies.
